mapper.select: SELECT s.station_id, s.station_no, s.station_name, s.fast_exit, CASE WHEN ts.station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_transfer FROM stations s LEFT JOIN transfer_stations ts ON s.station_id = ts.station_id ORDER BY s.station_no

SELECT s.station_id, s.station_no, s.station_name, s.fast_exit, CASE WHEN ts.station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_transfer FROM stations s LEFT JOIN transfer_stations ts ON s.station_id = ts.station_id WHERE s.station_id = #{stationId}

SELECT s.station_id, s.station_no, s.station_name, s.fast_exit, CASE WHEN ts.station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_transfer FROM stations s LEFT JOIN transfer_stations ts ON s.station_id = ts.station_id WHERE s.station_name = #{stationName}

SELECT s.station_id, s.station_no, s.station_name, s.fast_exit, CASE WHEN ts.station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_transfer FROM stations s LEFT JOIN transfer_stations ts ON s.station_id = ts.station_id WHERE s.station_no = #{stationNo}

SELECT s.station_id, s.station_no, s.station_name, s.fast_exit, CASE WHEN ts.station_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_transfer FROM stations s INNER JOIN station_lines sl ON s.station_id = sl.station_id INNER JOIN `lines` l ON sl.line_id = l.line_id LEFT JOIN transfer_stations ts ON s.station_id = ts.station_id WHERE l.line_no = #{lineNo} ORDER BY sl.station_order
SELECT s.station_id, s.station_no, s.station_name, s.fast_exit, 1 as is_transfer FROM stations s INNER JOIN transfer_stations ts ON s.station_id = ts.station_id ORDER BY s.station_no
SELECT l.line_no FROM `lines` l INNER JOIN station_lines sl ON l.line_id = sl.line_id WHERE sl.station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY l.line_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stations (station_no, station_name, fast_exit) VALUES (#{stationNo}, #{stationName}, #{fastExit})
